scope: Initialization, stage, state observation and transaction behavior of one pinned implementation; no full material execution or canonical model admission.

cases.setup: Construct a fresh valid 3D material with all options explicit.
cases.source_prediction: Stored stress and strain are zero; initial tangent is evaluated using auxiliary isotropic P_atm. Do not infer consolidated stress from the tangent.

cases.setup: Explicit stage 0 after construction. Apply internal normal strains p_target/(3*K0) once to a fresh material, then commit.
cases.source_prediction: Expected stress is p_target*I; e=e_init-(1+e_init)*p_target/K0; alpha=0. Compare the complete state and tangent, not stress alone.

cases.setup: Explicit stage 0. Apply normal and all shear strains to a fresh material, then commit with positive resulting p_raw.
cases.source_prediction: The elastic branch assigns alpha=dev(stress_next)/p_raw. Fabric begins zero; anisotropic prepared alpha must not be replaced with zero.

cases.setup: Stage 1 at trial or committed means below, equal to, and above p_min; include unequal trial/committed states.
cases.source_prediction: Either strictly low mean triggers replacement of both stresses by p_min*I and both alphas by zero. Equality alone does not satisfy the test; inspect other fields for their distinct behavior.

cases.setup: Above the pressure-floor branch, switch to stage 1 with trial eta below, equal to, and above supplied Mc.
cases.source_prediction: Only eta>Mc sets effective Mc to 1.1*eta. Inspect supplied/effective parameters and do not treat the transition as a stress projection.

cases.setup: Change trial stress without commit, then request stage 1; replay from a fresh process for comparison.
cases.source_prediction: The floor predicate uses both trial and committed means; critical-ratio calculation uses trial stress. Stage changes must therefore have explicit commit boundaries.

cases.setup: In isolated processes, vary construction/copy order and update stage on one of two material instances.
cases.source_prediction: mElastFlag is static; class-tag null construction sets it to zero. The 3D no-argument getCopy invokes that constructor. Verify effects on both instances and explicitly select stage after setup.

cases.setup: Replay an identical prepared state with absolute preparation strain retained, then compare an intentionally rebased laboratory origin.
cases.source_prediction: e=e_init-(1+e_init)*trace(total_strain). Retaining prepared e and incremental coefficient (1+e_init) reproduces this relation; replacing the coefficient with (1+e_current) defines another law.

cases.setup: At nonzero total volumetric strain, request a current void ratio via parameter update 8, away from eps_v=1.
cases.source_prediction: e_init becomes (e_requested+eps_v)/(1-eps_v); the method does not immediately assign mVoidRatio. Subsequent stiffness uses the changed e_init. Observe before and after integration/commit.

cases.setup: Create a loading reversal. Read direct 3D state, base state response and alpha_in response before and after commit.
cases.source_prediction: Base state and alpha_in expose committed memory; direct 3D getState packs trial memory. Check both accessor route and packet shear/sign conventions.

cases.setup: From the same committed state, evaluate A then B without commit and compare B against fresh-process replay of the committed prefix followed by B.
cases.source_prediction: Characterize any order dependence: reversal guard reads mutable mCe, and the material rollback method is empty. Agreement is not assumed.

cases.setup: After nonzero committed elastic strain and plastic loading, exercise revertToLastCommit, ordinary revertToStart and initial-state-analysis reset separately.
cases.source_prediction: Record exact outputs. Last-commit rollback is unimplemented; initialize does not explicitly clear mEpsilonE_n or mDGamma_n; initial-state-analysis reset skips initialization. Check parameter and static-stage retention too.

unresolved: Full material reference execution, including constructor, copy and reset behavior.
